question.text: The mode of propagation used by short wave broadcast services having a frequency range from a few <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>MHz</mi></math> up to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>30</mn><mo> </mo><mi>MHz</mi></math> is

solution.text:
Sky wave propagation is used by short wave broadcast services having a frequency range from few MHz up to 30 to 40 MHz

Long-distance communication can be achieved by ionosphere reflection of radio waves back towards the earth as shown in Fig. This mode of propagation is called skywave propagation.
